caption: The drawing depicts a single, light beige or off-white shoe with decorative embroidery, positioned slightly to the left of the center on a plain, cream-colored background. The shoe features a pointed toe and rises slightly at the back, resembling a soft slipper or indoor shoe. The upper front part of the shoe is adorned with intricate floral embroidery in shades of pink and green, with a large pink flower at the top center, leafy patterns in green, and smaller pink buds and blossoms extending downwards. There are also two feathery blue or lavender shapes flanking the central embroidery. The artist's signature, "Romano," appears to the right and slightly below the shoe. No other objects or elements are present in the composition.
title: Baby's Shoe
